facts.text: The hotel began as a fisherman's guesthouse and keeps to its nautical roots.
facts.excerpt: What began as a charming fisherman’s guesthouse stays true to its nautical roots to offer a stylish welcome for all guests.

facts.text: The hotel has a central Portofino location.
DaV Mare serves harbourside Ligurian dining.
facts.excerpt: Habourside Ligurian dining at DaV Mare

facts.text: DaV Mare Bar serves cocktails in Portofino's Piazzetta.
facts.excerpt: DaV Mare Bar for cocktails in Portofino’s Piazzetta

facts.text: Gelateria San Giorgio offers ice cream and sweet treats.
facts.excerpt: Gelateria San Giorgio for ice cream and sweet treats

facts.text: Guests have access to Bagni Fiore beach.
Guests have access to the facilities at the sister hotel, Splendido.
facts.excerpt: Access to facilities at our sister hotel, Splendido

facts.text: A complimentary shuttle runs to Splendido.
The hotel is a 1-hour drive from Genoa Airport.
The hotel offers in-room spa treatments.
Boat excursions and water sports are offered.
Wellness options include a meditation session that can be booked during a stay.

facts.text: The hotel has one event venue for up to 60 guests.
